notes: Demonstration values only. Do not send directly to real motors. These right-arm templates are preview-only and approximate.

right_arm_reset_pose.name: right_arm_reset_pose
right_arm_reset_pose.description: Coarse right-arm reset/default pose for preview only.
right_arm_reset_pose.safety_note: Preview only. No real robot motion is commanded.

right_arm_point_red_object.name: right_arm_point_red_object
right_arm_point_red_object.description: Right arm points toward the red object using a coarse preview pose.
right_arm_point_red_object.safety_note: Preview only. No real robot motion is commanded.

right_arm_reach_forward.name: right_arm_reach_forward
right_arm_reach_forward.description: Right arm reaches toward the object area without attempting a grasp.
right_arm_reach_forward.purpose: move hand toward object area, not grasp yet
right_arm_reach_forward.safety_note: Preview only. No real robot motion is commanded.

right_arm_pre_grasp.name: right_arm_pre_grasp
right_arm_pre_grasp.description: Right arm moves to a coarse pre-grasp pose near the target object before closing.
right_arm_pre_grasp.purpose: place hand near object before closing
right_arm_pre_grasp.safety_note: Preview only. No real robot motion is commanded.

right_arm_grasp_attempt.name: right_arm_grasp_attempt
right_arm_grasp_attempt.description: Simplified preview of reaching the object area and closing the hand.
right_arm_grasp_attempt.purpose: simplified grasp attempt: reach object area and close hand
right_arm_grasp_attempt.safety_note: Preview only. This is not guaranteed grasp success and no real robot motion is commanded.

right_arm_close_hand.name: right_arm_close_hand
right_arm_close_hand.description: Right hand close state shown without changing arm pose.
right_arm_close_hand.safety_note: Preview only. No real hand close command is sent.

right_arm_lift_pose.name: right_arm_lift_pose
right_arm_lift_pose.description: Right arm lift pose after a hypothetical simplified grasp attempt.
right_arm_lift_pose.purpose: lift pose after a simplified grasp attempt
right_arm_lift_pose.safety_note: Preview only. No real robot motion is commanded.

right_arm_touch_forward.name: right_arm_touch_forward
right_arm_touch_forward.description: Preview a forward touch approach that keeps the hand aimed toward the object instead of lifting upward.
right_arm_touch_forward.purpose: touch the object from the front with a conservative forward approach
right_arm_touch_forward.orientation_note: Experimental touch-forward preview. Existing robot execution may still be limited by commandable shoulder/elbow joints.
right_arm_touch_forward.safety_note: Preview first. Do not execute on the real robot unless supervised and safety is confirmed.

right_arm_touch_side.name: right_arm_touch_side
right_arm_touch_side.description: Preview a side-touch approach intended to contact the object from the robot-right side rather than from above.
right_arm_touch_side.purpose: touch the object from the side to reduce table collision risk
right_arm_touch_side.orientation_note: Experimental side-touch preview. It avoids a top-down contact assumption and should be validated slowly.
right_arm_touch_side.safety_note: Preview first. Do not execute on the real robot unless supervised and safety is confirmed.

right_arm_pre_grasp_side.name: right_arm_pre_grasp_side
right_arm_pre_grasp_side.description: Preview a side pre-grasp pose with the hand opened and angled toward the object.
right_arm_pre_grasp_side.purpose: prepare for a conservative side grasp near the red object
right_arm_pre_grasp_side.wrist_forearm_orientation_note: Preview assumes the physical right XL-320 wrist is aligned downward before final close.
right_arm_pre_grasp_side.safety_note: Preview first. No real robot motion is commanded by this template.

right_arm_touch_downward.name: right_arm_touch_downward
right_arm_touch_downward.description: Preview a downward wrist touch pose without lowering the whole arm into the table.
right_arm_touch_downward.purpose: test wrist-down contact orientation while keeping a safe z height
right_arm_touch_downward.wrist_forearm_orientation_note: Use this to compare wrist-down orientation against the upward check-mark failure case.
right_arm_touch_downward.safety_note: Preview first. Do not execute on the real robot unless supervised and safety is confirmed.

right_arm_grasp_attempt_side.name: right_arm_grasp_attempt_side
right_arm_grasp_attempt_side.description: Preview a side grasp attempt: approach at safe height, close hand, then lift/retreat.
right_arm_grasp_attempt_side.purpose: template for a staged side grasp primitive, not guaranteed grasp success
right_arm_grasp_attempt_side.wrist_forearm_orientation_note: Close only after the hand is near the object and the wrist is aligned downward/sideways.
right_arm_grasp_attempt_side.safety_note: Preview first. This template is not automatically sent to real motors.

right_arm_lift_retreat.name: right_arm_lift_retreat
right_arm_lift_retreat.description: Preview a small lift and retreat after a possible grasp.
right_arm_lift_retreat.wrist_forearm_orientation_note: Retreat should be small and upward after close; no contact physics is simulated.
right_arm_lift_retreat.safety_note: Preview only. No real robot motion is commanded.
